en.headline: MTR warns of cash flow pressure despite Northern Link land grants
en.dek: Chief executive Jeny Yeung said the rail-plus-property model has a long cycle for returns even as proceeds from eight new sites are expected to cover the Northern Link.
body: The MTR Corporation has warned that it faces significant cash flow pressures over the next few years despite receiving eight new land sites from the government for the Northern Link project in the Northern Metropolis.

Chief executive Jeny Yeung Mei-chun told reporters on Saturday that proceeds from the sale of the eight sites would be sufficient to subsidise construction and maintenance of the new rail line as well as fund asset upgrades. She noted that the rail-plus-property model typically requires a long cycle before returns materialise, creating heavy financial pressure in the interim.

The Northern Link’s projected capital cost has been reduced by 28 per cent to HK$86.2 billion, with both the main line and spur line targeted for completion in 2034. Yeung said the company was not concerned about cost overruns and would control costs through technology and the adoption of mainland railway standards for greater procurement flexibility. Peak construction is expected between 2029 and 2031, and the corporation has built cash reserves by issuing bonds and securing credit during favourable interest-rate periods.
A research group has cast doubt on the model, noting that about a third of the 18 sites granted in total remained idle after developers opted for cash compensation rather than development.

zh.headline: 港鐵警告北環線土地撥備下仍面臨現金流壓力
zh.dek: 行政總裁楊美珍表示，鐵路加物業模式回報周期較長，即使八幅新地皮收益預計可覆蓋北環線建設及資產更新。
body: 港鐵公司警告，即使政府撥備八幅新地皮用於北部都會區北環線項目，未來數年仍將面臨顯著現金流壓力。
行政總裁楊美珍周六向傳媒表示，出售該八幅地皮的收益足以補貼新鐵路線的建設及維修，以及資助資產更新。她指出，鐵路加物業模式通常需要較長周期才能產生回報，期間會帶來沉重財政壓力。
北環線預計資本成本已削減百分之二十八至862億港元，主線及支線目標於2034年通車。楊美珍表示公司不擔心超支，會透過科技及採用內地鐵路標準以增加採購靈活性來控制成本。建造高峰期預計在2029至2031年間，公司已在利率有利時發行債券及取得信貸以累積現金儲備。
有研究團體對該模式表示質疑，指總共獲撥的十八幅地皮中約三分之一仍閒置，發展商選擇收取現金補償而非進行發展。
